subject: [QBR] Mission Control: account sprint & forecast merge
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-20T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: [QBR] Mission Control: account sprint & forecast merge

Team —

Quick HQ note as we lock the QBR packet: I pulled a first pass consolidated forecast and an account snapshot workbook (attached: QBR_account_snapshots.xlsx + pipeline_heatmap.png). The goal for today is to converge on an account-by-account one-pager set we can hand to the Execs by tomorrow noon.

Asks: 
- Owners: please update your account one-pagers with the canonical forecast (ARR / close plan / blockers) and a 2-line risk note. Use the \"Forecast (Final)\" tab in the workbook.
- Commit window: EOD today for anything that moves the closed date or ACV.
- Redlines: if you change stage/probability materially, add a short justification in the workbook comment column so finance can trace changes.

High-priority accounts flagged from my pass: 
1) Acme Corp — drop from $1.8M to $1.25M unless we see a firm procurement date; needs a mutual-action plan (I started a stub).
2) NovaHealth — on track but needs integration timelines confirmed; low technical risk.
3) BlueBay — stalled on legal, likely slip.

Links: drive folder + HS record below. I attached a quick heatmap that shows risk distribution by owner.

Attachments: QBR_account_snapshots.xlsx (workbook), pipeline_heatmap.png (snapshot).

If you hit blockers (security evidence, procurement variance), call out here so I can escalate.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [QBR] Mission Control: account sprint & forecast merge

Jordan —

Got it. Two executive asks to fold in: 1) a one-line customer impact statement for top-6 accounts, 2) confirmation of any SLA / deployment exceptions we are promising.

Quick notes inline: 
- Acme Corp: high priority. Agree we need a firm procurement commit or pull-down in the forecast. If Procurement asks for a 60-day payment term we should model conservatively.
- NovaHealth: please confirm the pilot end date (Peter).

Attaching: exec_asks.docx (short template). Use the last tab in your workbook to paste the exec-friendly lines.

If anyone needs me to escalate a procurement ask to field CS, ping me and I will loop in Support.

Tessa Morgan
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Jordan / Tessa / Karthik —

Uploading my updates and a short packet (attached: Acme_mutual-action-plan.docx, account_onepagers.pdf). Highlights by account (short):

- Acme Corp — Current ask: procurement date pushed; expected close now mid-SEP. New ACV estimate: $1.25M (was $1.8M). Action: Elaine (Acme) wants a signed MPA + security SLA before PO. I've attached a mutual-action plan draft; legal is reviewing today. Risk: HIGH (procurement cadence + PO timing). Owner: Marissa -> chasing procurement.

- NovaHealth — Pilot ends 9/8; integration task complete. Finance will sign off after pilot metrics. New ACV unchanged ($420k). Risk: MEDIUM (metrics dependency). Owner: Rahul (field).

- BlueBay — Legal hold; LOE for their custom network needs estimate pending. Likely push to Q4. Owner: Darrell.

Notes: I added exec lines to the workbook (ExecSummary tab) per Tessa's template. I also added comments in the workbook for any probability changes.

Attachments: Acme_mutual-action-plan.docx, account_onepagers.pdf.

Marissa Cole
Director, Account Strategy
Redwood Inference

Perfect — thank you all for the rapid updates. Squad plan:

- Marissa, finalize Acme MPA and confirm procurement date by 18:00 PT. If we do not have a PO or firm date, Finance will accept the $1.25M adjusted number for the packet.
- Jordan, please lock the Forecast (Final) tab after EOD and generate the QBR packet.
- Tessa, I'll review exec lines and pull SLA exceptions into the final summary.

I'll prep the consolidated slide (final) and circulate before 09:00 tomorrow for a last look. If anyone needs me to escalate to legal or to the CRO, flag here.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Analytics
Redwood Inference
